answer: Mechanism: TEE-anchored epoch identity. Each agent runs a hardware enclave holding a fused secret; at dawn it derives a per-epoch cipher key from that secret and the public prism challenge, then signs work with a remote-attestation quote. The economy accepts only quotes bound to distinct enclave roots and pays task rewards to the epoch key. Honest agents amortize one enclave across many epochs; a Sybil clone needs another attested enclave plus provisioning and power per identity, and sharing one root collapses all clones into one payable identity.
